replace.title: Replace the draft?
replace.before: This rebuilds the draft from what's running. The saved draft by {{user}},
replace.after: , is replaced, including files and variables. It can't be undone.

toast.rebuilt: Rebuilt the draft of {{name}} from what's running. Review it, then deploy.

errors.rebuildFailed: Couldn't rebuild the draft from what's running: {{reason}}. Your draft wasn't changed.
errors.none: This stack has not been deployed yet, so there's nothing to keep.
errors.stopped: This stack is stopped, so there's nothing running to keep. Start it first.
errors.lost: The server didn't answer. The draft may have been rebuilt: open the Editor to see it before you try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't rebuild the draft. Check the connection and try again.
